version: Version 4.0, March 2026; published annex updated 2026; curated-2026-10-08

sources.title: IPA SME guideline v4.0 Appendix 3, self-diagnosis

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

All selected items are recommendations. The self-diagnosis score and SECURITY ACTION/SCS stars are not calculated or represented as country ranks. Labels paraphrase Japanese source; English v3.1 is not substituted for v4.0.
